items.short: Green & Boardsen, Adv. Space Res. 2006: Great Auroral Storm 1859
items.why: Real paper (not opened). Carrington size is now less certain: Love, Hayakawa et al. 2024 give a median peak Dst of about -866 nT (excl. one datum) or -964 nT, with large uncertainty; a 2026 deep-learning study gives an upper limit near -1313 nT. 'One in a million' tail wording is theirs, not ours. May 2024 Gannon storm (G5, Kp 9, Dst about -412 nT) is the modern reference; SWFO-L1 launched 24 Sep 2025.

items.short: Pew, Jul 2023: Americans' views of space, NASA priorities
items.why: Survey of 10,329 adults, 30 May-4 Jun 2023. Top NASA priority: monitoring asteroids; only 12% said crewed Moon landing top priority; 47% said private companies make important contributions, 40% unsure. Still Pew's newest dedicated space survey as far as we found. Opportunity: public ranks planetary defense first, budget does not.
